insights.one_liner: Zurich Insurance Benelux insures businesses from The Hague; it sponsors visas, but its hybrid compliance role needs Dutch and drew about 91 LinkedIn applicants.

culture.text: Zurich Benelux insures local and international businesses in the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg and describes its culture as inclusive.
Its one open job here is a full-time hybrid risk and compliance role in The Hague.
The wider group is large, with 52,930 staff in 2020.

open.text: Zurich Insurance Europe AG is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its current job here requires Dutch.

growth.text: The group had revenue of USD 59 billion in 2020.
Zurich beat its operating profit forecast, led by its property and casualty business.

worth_knowing.text: Zurich completed its USD 10.8 billion takeover of Beazley, which AMweb says makes it the world's largest specialty insurer.
With the deal, Beazley CEO Adrian Cox stepped down and Terryn was named specialty CEO.
